verdict.rationale: Plausible ships its own APIs: a Stats API with a /api/v2/query endpoint for simple and complex queries, and an Events API for recording pageviews and custom events. The Stats API is explicitly read-only, and nothing in the evidence shows API control over UI actions such as goals, funnels, annotations, shared links, team members or reports, so parity with the UI is far from shown. missing for 10: write/management API for sites, goals, funnels and annotations, API for team/shared-link/report configuration, documented UI-to-API parity, published OpenAPI spec (probe 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Plausible Stats API is a read-only HTTP interface for viewing historical and real-time stats.
The /api/v2/query endpoint accepts simple and complex stats queries in the POST request body and returns the metrics as JSON.
The Plausible Events API can be used to record pageviews and custom events.
